api.execution: Pure deterministic read-only mapping in tools/workflow_assurance.py; no new CLI, subprocess, model, network, filesystem/state writes or prerequisite/recovery engine. Reuse tools/convergent_review.py validate_ledger(ledger, ctx='ledger') as existing authoritative validator; do not change it or recompute convergence/lifecycle/suppression.
api.inputs: Both inputs must be finite acyclic JSON objects. report requires final_verdict object with approved of exact bool type and the three array fields issues, missing_acceptance_coverage, unsupported_claims; optional required_fixes must be an array. Extra JSON report metadata is allowed. expected_repository must be a valid repository string and expected_head_sha a lowercase40hex Git commit; both must equal validated ledger repository/head_sha. No inferred defaults, truthiness or string coercion.
api.errors: Missing/wrong-shaped/non-JSON inputs, wrong approval type (including1/null/string), invalid ledger/count/verdict/fingerprint, malformed expected binding or repository/head mismatch raise existing AssuranceError without successful output or input mutation. Translate convergent ReviewError into AssuranceError.
api.blocking: From validated ledger findings in existing order, select unsuppressed new/persisting/reopened blocker or important. Append deep copies of these full findings to existing report.issues. Never remove, downgrade or overwrite an incoming blocking-array entry. Resolved/suppressed findings do not newly block; active minor alone does not newly block.
api.output: Return exactly final_verdict, issues, missing_acceptance_coverage, unsupported_claims, required_fixes and advisory_minor. Deep-copy report.final_verdict (retaining summary/metadata), the three arrays and optional required_fixes(default[]). Append one fix per blocking finding: {fingerprint: finding.fingerprint, required_fix: finding.title + ': ' + finding.description}. advisory_minor is deep copies of active new/persisting/reopened minor findings in ledger order. No output aliases either input.
api.approval: Set output.final_verdict.approved to the conjunction: input approved is exactly True, all three resulting blocking arrays are empty, and authoritative ledger.verdict is approve. False approval remains false even with empty arrays. Advisory minor never clears a carried blocker or a nonempty array. Output required_fixes/advisory_minor are explanatory; they cannot override this gate.
api.trust_boundary: Caller supplies the authoritative converged ledger and explicit expected bindings; mapping validates its structure/relations and bindings, not artifact provenance or authentication. It does not regenerate a ledger from observations, authorize work or advance coordination state. Existing convergence remains responsible for prior-ledger carry and authorized suppression.

verification.acceptance_test: AT1 approve-empty: valid empty authoritative ledger and strict true/empty report approve; malformed data, nonboolean approval, false approval and wrong repository/head fail closed with positive controls.

AT2 advisory-visible: active minor remains visible separately without newly blocking valid empty arrays; minor cannot erase existing blocker/important or AGF arrays. Preserve input and output independence.

AT3 block-carried: new/persisting/reopened unsuppressed blocker and important remain issues/fixes even when current observations omit prior finding; positive resolved/suppressed controls and authoritative malformed-count rejection.
AT4 reject-issues: each preserved nonempty issues array rejects even with true input/approve ledger; same valid report restored empty approves.
AT5 reject-missing-coverage: each preserved nonempty missing_acceptance_coverage array rejects despite true input/approve ledger; restored empty positive approves.
AT6 reject-unsupported: each preserved nonempty unsupported_claims array rejects despite true input/approve ledger; restored empty positive approves.
